fuZJw"><h1 class="sc-fzqPZZ hQgKkw"><span class="sc-fzoxKX eJUqAq">NOWPayments API</span></h1></div><div class="sc-fzpkJw gEiHfF"><div class="sc-fzpans jytdVw"><p><span>NOWPayments is a non-custodial cryptocurrency payment processing platform. Accept payments in a wide range of cryptos and get them instantly converted into a coin of your choice and sent to your wallet. Keeping it simple – no excess.</span></p><span>
</span><h1 id="authentication" class="sc-fzplWN kiyfHX"><span>Authentication</span></h1><span>
</span><p><span>To use the NOWPayments API you should do the following:</span></p><span>
</span><ul class="sc-fzpjYC dxMBgk"><span>
</span><li><p><span>Sign up at </span><a class="sc-fznMAR eQgfLs markdown-link" href="https://nowpayments.io" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener nofollow"><span>nowpayments.io</span></a><span>;</span></p><span>
</span></li><span>
</span><li><p><span>Specify your payout wallet;</span></p><span>
</span></li><span>
</span><li><p><span>Generate an API key and IPN secret key;</span><br><span>  Please note: IPN secret key may be shown fully only upon creation. Make sure to save it after generation.</span></p><span>
</span></li><span>
</span></ul><span>
</span><h1 id="nowpayments-integration-guide" class="sc-fzplWN kiyfHX"><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>NOWPayments Integration Guide</span></strong></h1><span>
</span><p><span>For more detailed information on how to integrate and use the NOWPayments API, please refer to our comprehensive </span><a class="sc-fznMAR eQgfLs markdown-link" href="https://nowpayments.notion.site/NOWPayments-Integration-Guide-40c516d0d940489d903b61efc002ba47" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener nofollow"><span>NOWPayments Integration Guide.</span></a><span> This guide provides step-by-step instructions on setting up and managing payouts, API requests, and other features to help you get started quickly and effectively.</span></p><span>
</span><h1 id="integration-scenarios" class="sc-fzplWN kiyfHX"><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>Integration Scenarios</span></strong></h1><span>
</span><p><span>For a deeper understanding of different integration possibilities, check out our </span><a class="sc-fznMAR eQgfLs markdown-link" href="https://nowpayments.notion.site/NOWPayments-2-Integration-Scenarios-for-Developers-313b318f4ddb80f28297f3839bc8b911" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener nofollow"><span>Integration Scenarios Guide</span></a><span>. This guide outlines possible integration methods, providing practical examples and insights to help you implement the best solution for your business needs.</span></p><span>
</span><h1 id="standard-e-commerce-flow-for-nowpayments-api" class="sc-fzplWN kiyfHX"><span>Standard e-commerce flow for NOWPayments API:</span></h1><span>
</span><ul class="sc-fznxsB dhIPUn"><span>
</span><li><p><span>API - Check API availability with the </span><a class="sc-fznMAR eQgfLs markdown-link" href="https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/7907941/2s93JusNJt#0316fd95-ad58-4d36-82c0-d94455d019ac" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener nofollow"><span>"GET API status"</span></a><span> method. If required, check the list of available payment currencies with the </span><a class="sc-fznMAR eQgfLs markdown-link" href="https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/7907941/2s93JusNJt#7bfbe4fb-440f-4e46-966b-2f452a70013c" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener nofollow"><span>"GET available currencies"</span></a><span> method;</span></p><span>
</span></li><span>
</span><li><p><span>UI - Ask a customer to select item/items for purchase to determine the total sum;</span></p><span>
</span></li><span>
</span><li><p><span>UI - Ask a customer to select payment currency;</span></p><span>
</span></li><span>
</span><li><p><span>API - Get the minimum payment amount for the selected currency pair (payment currency to your payout wallet currency) with the </span><a class="sc-fznMAR eQgfLs markdown-link" href="https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/7907941/2s93JusNJt#ce3fe3a3-00cd-4df2-bfba-641fde741da7" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener nofollow"><span>"GET Minimum payment amount"</span></a><span> method;</span></p><span>
</span></li><span>
</span><li><p><span>API - Get the estimate of the total amount in crypto with </span><a class="sc-fznMAR eQgfLs markdown-link" href="https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/7907941/2s93JusNJt#3c86a16e-94ad-4230-a470-4e833766a4c7" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener nofollow"><span>"GET Estimated price"</span></a><span> and check that it is larger than the minimum payment amount from step 4;</span></p><span>
</span></li><span>
</span><li><p><span>API - Call the </span><a class="sc-fznMAR eQgfLs markdown-link" href="https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/7907941/2s93JusNJt#74c91a83-da39-4e39-b3db-1ed4c5c233f8" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener nofollow"><span>"POST Create payment"</span></a><span> method to create a payment and get the deposit address (in our example, the generated BTC wallet address is returned from this method);</span></p><span>
</span></li><span>
</span><li><p><span>UI - Ask a customer to send the payment to the generated deposit address (in our example, user has to send BTC coins);</span></p><span>
</span></li><span>
</span><li><p><span>UI - A customer sends coins, NOWPayments processes and exchanges them (if required), and settles the payment to your payout wallet (in our example, to your ETH address);</span></p><span>
</span></li><span>
</span><li><p><span>API - You can get the payment status either via our IPN callbacks or manually, using </span><a class="sc-fznMAR eQgfLs markdown-link" href="https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/7907941/2s93JusNJt#62a6d281-478d-4927-8cd0-f96d677b8de6" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener nofollow"><span>"GET Payment Status"</span></a><span> and display it to a customer so that they know when their payment has been processed;</span></p><span>
</span></li><span>
</span><li><p><span>API - you call the list of payments made to your account via the </span><a class="sc-fznMAR eQgfLs markdown-link" href="https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/7907941/2s93JusNJt#c38d2410-1523-4313-8764-0043ba1cb24f" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener nofollow"><span>"GET List of payments"</span></a><span> method;</span></p><span>
</span></li><span>
</span><li><p><span>Additionally, you can see all of this information in your </span><a class="sc-fznMAR eQgfLs markdown-link" href="https://account.nowpayments.io/payments" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener nofollow"><span>Account</span></a><span> on NOWPayments website;</span></p><span>
</span></li><span>
</span></ul><span>

</span><h2 class="sc-fznyAO fTNtXF"><span>Instant Payments Notifications</span></h2><span>
</span><p><span>IPN (Instant payment notifications, or callbacks) are used to notify you when transaction status is changed.</span><br><span>To use them, you should complete the following steps:</span></p><span>
</span><ul class="sc-fznxsB dhIPUn"><span>
</span><li><p><span>Generate and save the IPN Secret key in Payment Settings tab at the Dashboard;</span></p><span>
</span></li><span>
</span><li><p><span>Insert your URL address where you want to get callbacks in create_payment request. The parameter name is ipn_callback_url. You will receive payment updates (statuses) to this URL address.**</span><br><span> Please, take note that we cannot send callbacks to your localhost unless it has dedicated IP address.**</span></p><span>
</span></li><span>
</span><li><p><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>important</span></strong><span> Please make sure that firewall software on your server (i.e. Cloudflare) does allow our requests to come through. It may be required to whitelist our IP addresses on your side to get it. The list of these IP addresses can be requested at </span><a class="sc-fznMAR eQgfLs markdown-link" href="https://mailto:partners@nowpayments.io" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener nofollow"><span>partners@nowpayments.io</span></a><span>;</span></p><span>
</span></li><span>
</span><li><p><span>You will receive all the parameters at the URL address you specified in (2) by POST request;</span><br><span> The POST request will contain the </span><em class="sc-fzoLag BNtsP"><span>x-nowpayments-sig</span></em><span> parameter in the header.</span><br><span> The body of the request is similiar to a </span><a class="sc-fznMAR eQgfLs markdown-link" href="https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/7907941/2s93JusNJt#62a6d281-478d-4927-8cd0-f96d677b8de6" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener nofollow"><span>get payment status</span></a><span> response body.</span><br><span> You can see examples in "Webhook examples" section.</span></p><span>
</span></li><span>
</span><li><p><span>Sort the POST request by keys and convert it to string using</span><br><span> </span><a class="sc-fznMAR eQgfLs markdown-link" href="https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/JSON/stringify" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener nofollow"><span>JSON.stringify</span></a><span> (params, Object.keys(params).sort()) or the same function;</span></p><span>
</span></li><span>
</span><li><p><span>Sign a string with an IPN-secret key with HMAC and sha-512 key;</span></p><span>
</span></li><span>
</span><li><p><span>Compare the signed string from the previous step with the x-nowpayments-sig , which is stored in the header of the callback request;</span><br><span> If these strings are similar, it is a success.</span><br><span> Otherwise, contact us on </span><a class="sc-fznMAR eQgfLs markdown-link" href="https://mailto:support@nowpayments.io" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener nofollow"><span>support@nowpayments.io</span></a><span> to solve the problem.</span></p><span>
</span></li><span>

</span><h2 class="sc-fznyAO fTNtXF"><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>Repeated Deposits and Wrong-Asset Deposits</span></strong></h2><span>
</span><p><span>This section explains how we handle two specific types of deposits: </span><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>repeated deposits (re-deposits)</span></strong><span> and </span><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>wrong-asset deposits</span></strong><span>. These deposits may require special processing or manual intervention, and understanding how they work will help you manage your payments more effectively.</span></p><span>
</span><ul class="sc-fznxsB dhIPUn"><span>
</span><li><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>Repeated Deposits</span></strong></li><span>
</span></ul><span>
</span><p><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>Repeated deposits</span></strong><span> are additional payments sent to the same deposit address that was previously used by a customer to fully or partially pay an invoice. These deposits are processed at the current exchange rate at the time they are received. They are marked with either the "Partially paid" or "Finished" status. If you need to clarify your current repeated-deposit settings, please check with your payment provider regarding the default status.</span></p><span>
</span><p><span>In the </span><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>Payments History</span></strong><span> section of the personal account, these payments are labeled as </span><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>"Re-deposit"</span></strong><span>. Additionally, in the payment details, the </span><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>Original payment ID</span></strong><span> field will display the ID of the original transaction.</span></p><span>
</span><p><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>Recommendation</span></strong><span>:</span></p><span>
</span><p><span>Recommendation: When integrating, we recommend tracking the </span><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>'parent_payment_id' parameter</span></strong><span> in </span><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>Instant Payment Notifications</span></strong><span> and being aware that the </span><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>total amount of repeated deposits may differ from the expected payment amount</span></strong><span>. This helps avoid the risk of providing services in cases of underpayment.</span><br><span>We do not recommend configuring your system to automatically provide services or ship goods based on any repeated-deposit status. If you choose to configure it this way, you should be aware of the risk of providing services in cases of underpayment. </span><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>For additional risk acceptance please refer to section 6 of our Terms of Service</span></strong><span>.</span></p><span>
</span><p><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>NB</span></strong><span>: Repeated deposits are always converted to the same asset as the original payment.</span><br><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>Note:</span></strong><span> To review the current flow or change the default status of repeated payments to "Finished" or "Partially paid", please contact us at </span><a class="sc-fznMAR eQgfLs markdown-link" href="https://mailto:support@nowpayments.io" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener nofollow"><span>support@nowpayments.io</span></a><span>.</span></p><span>
</span><p><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>2. Wrong-Asset Deposits</span></strong></p><span>
</span><p><span>Wrong-asset deposits occur when a payment is sent using the wrong network or asset (e.g. a user may mistakenly send </span><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>USDTERC20</span></strong><span> instead of </span><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>ETH)</span></strong><span>, and this network and asset are supported by our service.</span></p><span>
</span><p><span>These payments will appear in the </span><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>Payments History</span></strong><span> section with the label </span><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>"Wrong Asset"</span></strong><span> and, by default, will require manual intervention to resolve.</span></p><span>
</span><p><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>Recommendation</span></strong><span>: When integrating, we recommend configuring your system to check the </span><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>amount, asset type</span></strong><span> and the '</span><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>parent_payment_id' param in Instant Payment Notifications</span></strong><span> of the incoming deposit to avoid the risks of providing services in case of insufficient funds.</span></p><span>
</span><p><span>If you want wrong-asset deposits to be processed automatically, you can enable the </span><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>Wrong-Asset Deposits Auto-Processing</span></strong><span> option in your account settings (Settings -> Payment -> Payment details). Before enabling this option, please take into account that </span><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>the final sum of the sent deposit may differ from the expected payment amount and by default</span></strong><span> these payments always receive "Finished" status.</span></p><span>
</span><p><span>If needed, we can also provide an option to assign a </span><strong class="sc-fzoXzr bUnOKm"><span>"partially paid"</span></strong><span> status to deposits processed through this feature. For more details, please contact </span><a class="sc-fznMAR eQgfLs markdown-link" href="https://mailto:support@nowpayments.io" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener nofollow"><b><span>support@nowpayments.io</span></b></a></p><span>
